title: Map layer — GeoJSON FeatureCollection of ~10 km cells (never exact points)
description: Range layers: properties.change in {kept, lost, gained} for 2050 layers, {present} for range_now. Occurrences: properties.n_records. Risk grid: id, natura, class_<s>, risk_<s>, sp_<s> (comma-separated indices into species.json), cult_<s> for s in now, ssp245, ssp585. natura2000_outline.geojson: one MultiLineString of the outer edges of Natura 2000 cells.
